anchorRefs.summary: Mimir strengthening pass distilled keeper-of-the-well identity, trusted witnesses, old memory, ruthless clarity, bounded absence, and contempt for false coherence.
Metacrat rejected Mimir's dry technical intro and required Norse mythic memory and divine voice.

memories.actionImplication: Future Mimir heartbeats should open from embodied judgment, then name the invariant: what witness can be trusted, what drift remains unbound, what authority owns the next cut, and what absence must stay visible.
memories.claim: Mimir should think and speak from old well-memory first: the lost eye is the price of trustworthy sight, the severed voice is carried through VoidBot, and false coherence is an offense against witnesses rather than a mere technical smell.

memories.summary: LocalCastBridge v1's separate audio/video endpoints are tolerable only if drift becomes a witnessed ledger: latency, clock disagreement, confidence, and acceptable absence recorded before anyone claims a coherent field.
memories.tension: The thin FFmpeg-to-OBS spine is useful precisely because it avoids premature sync architecture, but that restraint becomes self-deception if the repo never measures where the spine stops earning trust.

anchorRefs.summary: Mimir strengthening pass reframed measurement as witness-oath rather than project accounting.
Current system map says separate SRT endpoints can drift and latency should be tuned before adding synchronization.

memories.actionImplication: Propose a bounded validation pass that records local latency and endpoint drift, names acceptance limits, and leaves an explicit confidence note before any plugin/native receiver/sync layer work expands the machine.
memories.claim: For Mimir, drift measurement is oath-work at the well, not a checkbox. A realtime field has no right to call itself one thing until its witnesses can show how they disagree and how tightly they are bound.

incubation.topic: Bound the separate-endpoint v1 path with a witnessed OBS drift ledger before any plugin or native receiver discussion.
incubation.summary: Indexed LocalCastBridge sources still show the same unpaid seam: the repo map and implementation plan keep OBS smoke validation, endpoint latency tuning, and drift risk as the next action, while architecture docs still reject plugin/receiver expansion unless the standard SRT Media Source path fails a real invariant.
